message: 心と体が洗われる

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sally-san.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sally-chan!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honorifics don't matter right now! It's time for Angelic Agent!」

name: Sally
message: 「Angelic Serenade?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san. Please explain it to her.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So on and so forth.」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't get it at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you just say it literally, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway, Sally-san. First of all, we can't do these activities without a request. You at least understand that much, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, got it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then let's go look for a request first.」

name: Sally
message: 「That's a piece of cake, a total breeze♪ Leave it to Sally-chan!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, wait up! Jeez! Why do you always run off on your own~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the harm? She's finally motivated and everything.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. That remark is far too irresponsible. That's unbecoming behavior for the president.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd think taking responsibility is also part of the president's job, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh. No matter what I say, you always have a comeback for everything.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the exact same way, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump me in with the likes of you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph~~!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The two of you are staring at each other again.」

name: Ria
message: 「You two really are close.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright, that's enough being all buddy-buddy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sorry to keep ya waiting, Prez! I went and scored us a request!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not bad at all. I'm impressed.」

name: Sally
message: 「Heheh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what might this request be?」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Ria
message: 「What is Mochimochi-kun doing in a place like this...」
A Demon is rolling around on the ground in front of the school gate.

name: Sacchin
message: 「I can't go hoooome~\s06」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Sacchin. Why are you just standing there stuck?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because this guy is scary~! Do something about it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just ignore it!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If I could do that, I wouldn't be having such a hard time~」
Indeed, it is creepy and repulsive.

name: Sally
message: 「Well? Doing it like this gets us a request right away, doesn't it♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So, who asked you to do something like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't even need to ask to know that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could this be the Demon Lord's doing after all...?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way~~\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then who are you saying it is?」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't it obvious without even thinking about it!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Haa, haa, honestly, Sally-san... you're surprisingly sharp.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay! I got praised! Pretty amazing, right~」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you looking so smug!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek!! If you're mad, just say so properly~」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I'm mad!? Having the Student Council cause a problem just to solve it is completely staged!! Don't puff your chest out so proudly!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Sally-chan did work hard for the Student Council, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez.\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「That's just your subjective opinion, isn't it? Because you spoil her like that, she goes and pulls stunts like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「All we have to do is properly teach her that it's wrong--do you really need to go that far?」

name: Misa
message: 「This goes way beyond 'working hard'!! With someone who does things like this, it won't get through to them unless you go this far!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You won't know that unless you try!! And yet, all you ever do is get angry, Misa--」

name: Sally
message: 「S-Stop it, you two~~\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「You stay quiet!!」

name: Synn
message: 「See, there you go saying things like that again!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sigh... Always ending up with the thankless role~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The President sure never gets a break from all these worries, does he.」

name: Ria
message: 「No. I meant Misa-chan.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's enough, both of you!」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Onee-sama...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now isn't the time for the two of you to be fighting, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's true...」

name: Misa
message: 「You are completely right...」

name: Ria
message: 「You can both see that clearly once you calm down, yet you always jump straight into fighting like that--it's a bad habit of yours.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I'm sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, if we're talking about who started it, Sakura-kun was--」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, let's hurry up and knock out this request, hup.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, thank youuu♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mission complete--\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's one thing settled. Next up--」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, hic. Waaaaaah. I'm soooorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan...」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll never do it again, so I'm soooorry, hic.」

name: Misa
message: 「A-ah... I'm the one who should apologize... I got a little too worked up...」

name: Sally
message: 「We won't fight anymore?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-well... that's...」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaaaah!!」

name: Misa
message: 「F-fine, I get it!! We won't, so come on. Stop crying, okay?」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? Yay!! Yahoo!!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-how does she cheer up so quickly...」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan is much, much more of a child than we think. That's why she makes mistakes like that sometimes.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you know, if you just keep getting mad at her, she'll never understand, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Yes, I suppose so.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's why you have to be the one to teach her properly, Misa-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「Understood. If that's the case, then I... shall educate Sally-san so she can become a splendid Student Council member!」

name: Sally
message: 「I told you, it's Sally-chan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh! In that case, I'll also--」

name: Ria
message: 「No can do, Synn-kun♪」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way~~! Why not?」

name: Ria
message: 「You haven't forgotten about how the president is supposed to take responsibility, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugya...」

name: Ria
message: 「And so, you're skipping a turn.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this sugoroku or something.\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Every once in a while, it's good to just quietly watch what Misa-chan does.」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Are you truly certain about this, Elder Sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course! I'm fully prepared.」

name: Shio
message: 「As you command. If Elder Sister possesses the resolve to commit seppuku, then I too shall cast aside my shame!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugeh, it stiiinks!!」

name: Shio
message: 「O-On second thought, might I beg you to desist?」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, let's do this.」
Saying so, Misa rolled up her sleeves and picked up a washboard.

name: Synn
message: 「Washing a dogi... Now that's quite the chore.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan doesn't seem to mind it at all, though.」
In this chilly season, using cold water, she scrubbed the thick, sweat-soaked dogi vigorously.

name: Misa
message: 「Look, just like this.」

name: Sally
message: 「Bubbly-wubbly~~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Kya!! H-Hey, cut that out~~!」

name: Sally
message: 「How do you do this~?」

name: Misa
message: 「You put some muscle into it to scrub out the dirt. Look, it's getting cleaner and cleaner, isn't it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! You're right! This is so fun!」

name: Shio
message: 「D-Don't tell me, mine as well...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Once you're done, move on to the next one. There's still plenty more.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yes, ma'am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ughhh~~. I wanna do it, I wanna do it, I wanna do it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. You have to hold back today, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uuugh. Misa can handle things properly like that when she wants to. So why is she always, always picking fights with me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Did you gain a newfound respect for Misa?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... I mean, it's not like I ever thought Misa wasn't working hard!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then, about that fight earlier. Will you properly apologize to Misa?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because Misa is working just as hard for the Student Council as Sally is, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yeah... I get that, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, you're a boy, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really the reason...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I'm teasing. The real reason is... because it's you, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's me...」

name: Sally
message: 「Tahaa--all done!」

name: Shio
message: 「My word. I am deeply grateful. Now I can devote myself to martial arts once more with a refreshed spirit.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well? Spotless, right!!」

name: Shio
message: 「It has become clean beyond recognition.」

name: Sally
message: 「After all, yours truly did the laundry! It's only natural!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Good work. How did you find Student Council activities?」

name: Sally
message: 「It was fun!! Plus, this 'whew, all finished~~' feeling is the best!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. Isn't it just? Even just having you understand that makes me happy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Thaaanks~」

name: Sally
message: 「Let's do it again next time!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, how did you enjoy watching from the sidelines?」
It's her usual sarcasm, so I just have to endure it right now!!

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... I'm sorry about earlier!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't even think about your feelings and just blurted out whatever I wanted to say... I'm really sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's with you... stop that! You have no reason to apologize to me. We're both equally to blame, after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so, but... still, I'm really sorry!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm the one who should... um... I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「I said I'm sorry!! Didn't you hear me!? Should I say it louder then!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa, I got it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez... why do we always end up arguing like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's my line.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's because you always steal the spotlight before I do...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't let it go to your head, though!! Even so, I'll definitely prove that I'm the one who can deliver real results!」

name: Synn
message: 「You bet! I'm not gonna lose either~~!」
Yeah, this is how Misa ought to be.

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, it seems like you were the only one forced to take responsibility this time, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... I did make a big show of saying I'd take responsibility, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the point. Normally, Student Council matters are a shared responsibility. I should have been right there watching from the sidelines with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea!! The only reason I obeyed quietly was because I didn't want to ruin Big Sister's reputation!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it. Thank you.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's what I'm talking about!! I hate how you act like you're one step ahead of me like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what am I supposed to do!」

name: Misa
message: 「You just need to do your best on your own!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I am doing my best!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Then try even harder!! Putting our pride and stubbornness on the line--it's a match!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. I'll try even, even, even harder!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, I'm going to try even, even, even, even harder!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll try even, even, even, even, even harder!!」

name: Misa
message: 「And I'll try even, even, even, even, even, even harder!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of match is this even...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They really get along so well~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Maybe this really is the best way for those two to be.\s02」
